title: Standoff at Padua/Pyrdiwah
detail: Armed confrontation began around the disputed Padua/Pyrdiwah area, with both sides advancing competing territorial claims and deploying border forces.

title: Boraibari fighting and heavy casualties
detail: Clashes spread near Boraibari and became the deadliest phase of the crisis, with significant losses among border personnel and wider diplomatic alarm.

title: Ceasefire and status-quo restoration steps
detail: Command-level contacts produced a ceasefire line and disengagement steps, containing the confrontation before it expanded into a broader interstate war.
